meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器内把附加的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档本地转成 Markdown 再阅读,文件不上传到托管解析器。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw agent 容器加上本地读取附加办公文档的能力,或 agent 需要读取附件但不愿上传到托管解析器时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 安装 AnyDoc,让 agent 本地转换办公文档
把这份附加的 DOCX 转成 Markdown 并总结相关段落
用 CSV 测试一下 AnyDoc 的本地转换是否可用
say.note: 在容器镜像里跑 anydoc 转换验证

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can convert attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel and similar office files to Markdown inside the NanoClaw agent container, reading them locally without uploading to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want NanoClaw agent containers to read attached office documents locally, or when an agent must read attachments without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Install AnyDoc for NanoClaw so agents convert office docs locally
Convert this attached DOCX to Markdown and summarize the relevant parts
Test AnyDoc's local conversion with a CSV in the container image
say_en.note: Runs anydoc --version and a CSV conversion
